languageModelTools.name: poler_edit_large_file
languageModelTools.displayName: POLER: Large File Search and Read
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Search exact literal text in a large workspace file with POLER Edit's mmap-backed piece table, or read a selected line window without loading the whole file into the model. For exact search, pass filePath and query. For large matches or files, page by passing startLine and lineCount; windows are limited by the model token budget. Does not support regular expressions.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Search or read a selected window from a large workspace file using POLER Edit.

filePath.description: Absolute path to a regular file inside an open workspace folder.

query.description: Optional exact literal string. Without startLine, searches the whole file and returns matching line and column locations. With startLine, filters the requested line window.

startLine.description: One-based line number to read from. Use this to page through a large file.

lineCount.description: Number of lines to request in the window; the response is shortened to fit the model token budget.

caseSensitive.description: Whether exact search is case-sensitive. Defaults to false.

poler.editCore.enabled.description: Увімкнути нативний сервіс poler-edit-core (Zero-Copy Piece-Table) для великих файлів.

poler.editCore.largeFileThresholdMB.description: Поріг (МБ), починаючи з якого файл обслуговується нативною Piece-Table замість повного завантаження в пам'ять Monaco.
